sourceFunctions.name: UOV
sourceFunctions.code:
function UOV takes nothing returns nothing
set NA=GetSpellAbilityUnit()
set VI=GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit())
set UR=GetSpellTargetLoc()
set TR[0]=AYV(200.,UR,Condition(function T_V))
set TR[1]=AYV(275.,UR,Condition(function T2V))
set TR[2]=AYV(350.,UR,Condition(function T5V))
if(UEV())then
call ForGroupBJ(TR[0],function UVV)
else
if(T9V())then
call ForGroupBJ(TR[1],function T8V)
else
if(T7V())then
call ForGroupBJ(TR[2],function T6V)
endif
endif
endif
call RemoveLocation(VI)
call RemoveLocation(UR)
call DestroyGroup(TR[0])
call DestroyGroup(TR[1])
call DestroyGroup(TR[2])
set YR=A0V('h02M')
call TriggerSleepAction(5.)
call ForGroupBJ(YR,function UXV)
call DestroyGroup(YR)
endfunction

sourceFunctions.name: ILE
sourceFunctions.code:
function ILE takes nothing returns nothing
if(IKE())then
call ModifyHeroStat(1,GetTriggerUnit(),0,20)
call TriggerSleepAction(25.)
call ModifyHeroStat(1,GetTriggerUnit(),1,20)
else
if(IJE())then
call ModifyHeroStat(1,GetTriggerUnit(),0,40)
call TriggerSleepAction(50.)
call ModifyHeroStat(1,GetTriggerUnit(),1,40)
else
call ModifyHeroStat(1,GetTriggerUnit(),0,80)
call TriggerSleepAction(50.)
call ModifyHeroStat(1,GetTriggerUnit(),1,80)
endif
endif
endfunction

sourceFunctions.name: IFE
sourceFunctions.code:
function IFE takes nothing returns nothing
set CR=GetTriggerUnit()
if(IDE())then
call ModifyHeroStat(1,CR,0,400)
call TriggerSleepAction(15.5)
call ModifyHeroStat(1,CR,1,400)
else
if(ICE())then
call ModifyHeroStat(1,CR,0,'d')
call TriggerSleepAction(10.5)
call ModifyHeroStat(1,CR,1,'d')
else
if(IBE())then
call ModifyHeroStat(1,CR,0,$C8)
call TriggerSleepAction(12.5)
call ModifyHeroStat(1,CR,1,$C8)
else
call ModifyHeroStat(1,CR,0,50)
call TriggerSleepAction(8.5)
call ModifyHeroStat(1,CR,1,50)
endif
endif
endif
endfunction

sourceFunctions.name: NKE
sourceFunctions.code:
function NKE takes nothing returns nothing
call TriggerSleepAction(.9)
set PE=GetSpellTargetLoc()
set SE=GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit())
if(NJE())then
call CreateNUnitsAtLocFacingLocBJ(1,'h025',GetTriggerPlayer(),PE,SE)
call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A024',bj_lastCreatedUnit,2)
call IssueImmediateOrderById(bj_lastCreatedUnit,$D009F)
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(10.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
else
if(NHE())then
call CreateNUnitsAtLocFacingLocBJ(1,'h025',GetTriggerPlayer(),PE,SE)
call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A024',bj_lastCreatedUnit,3)
call IssueImmediateOrderById(bj_lastCreatedUnit,$D009F)
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(10.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
else
if(NGE())then
call CreateNUnitsAtLocFacingLocBJ(1,'h025',GetTriggerPlayer(),PE,SE)
call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A024',bj_lastCreatedUnit,4)
call IssueImmediateOrderById(bj_lastCreatedUnit,$D009F)
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(10.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
else
call CreateNUnitsAtLocFacingLocBJ(1,'h025',GetTriggerPlayer(),PE,SE)
call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A024',bj_lastCreatedUnit,1)
call IssueImmediateOrderById(bj_lastCreatedUnit,$D009F)
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(10.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
endif
endif
endif
call RemoveLocation(PE)
call RemoveLocation(SE)
endfunction

sourceFunctions.name: NQE
sourceFunctions.code:
function NQE takes nothing returns nothing
call TriggerSleepAction(.9)
set SE=GetSpellTargetLoc()
call AddSpecialEffectLocBJ(SE,"Units\\NightElf\\Wisp\\WispExplode.mdl")
call DestroyEffect(bj_lastCreatedEffect)
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h01U',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),SE,bj_UNIT_FACING)
set PE=GetUnitLoc(bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(3.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h01U',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),OffsetLocation(PE,100.,0),bj_UNIT_FACING)
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(5.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h01U',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),OffsetLocation(PE,-200.,0),bj_UNIT_FACING)
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(7.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call RemoveLocation(PE)
call RemoveLocation(SE)
endfunction

call DisableTrigger(GetTriggeringTrigger())

sourceFunctions.name: E6E
sourceFunctions.code:
function E6E takes nothing returns nothing
set OE=GetTriggerUnit()
set RE=AngleBetweenPoints(GetUnitLoc(OE),GetSpellTargetLoc())
set IE=ADV(GetSpellTargetLoc(),.0,RE)
set AE=ADV(IE,(150.*SinBJ((18.*I2R(bj_forLoopAIndex)))),(RE+180.))
call AddSpecialEffectLocBJ(GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()),"Abilities\\Weapons\\Bolt\\BoltImpact.mdl")
call TriggerSleepAction(.5)
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h026',GetOwningPlayer(OE),IE,RE)
call UnitAddAbility(bj_lastCreatedUnit,'A025')
call IssuePointOrderByIdLoc(bj_lastCreatedUnit,$D0271,AE)
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(1.5,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call TriggerSleepAction(1.)
call DestroyEffect(bj_lastCreatedEffect)
endfunction

sourceFunctions.name: XQE
sourceFunctions.code:
function XQE takes nothing returns nothing
set TF=GetTriggerUnit()
set WF=GetSpellTargetLoc()
call SetUnitFacingToFaceLocTimed(GetTriggerUnit(),WF,.01)
call TriggerSleepAction(.01)
call SetUnitAnimation(GetTriggerUnit(),"spell")
call TriggerSleepAction(.75)
call PauseUnit(GetTriggerUnit(),true)
if(XKE())then
call SetUnitInvulnerable(GetTriggerUnit(),true)
endif
call SetUnitTimeScalePercent(TF,400.)
call CreateNUnitsAtLocFacingLocBJ(1,'h031',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),WF,WF)
call SelectUnitRemoveForPlayer(GetTriggerUnit(),GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))
call RemoveLocation(WF)
set LF=bj_lastCreatedUnit
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(7.5,'BTLF',LF)
set KR=GetUnitLoc(bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call SelectUnitForPlayerSingle(LF,GetTriggerPlayer())
call SetCameraTargetControllerNoZForPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(TF),LF,0,-625.,false)
set CG[0]=M3V(KR,250.,0)
set CG[1]=M3V(KR,225.,45.)
set CG[2]=M3V(KR,250.,90.)
set CG[3]=M3V(KR,225.,135.)
set CG[4]=M3V(KR,250.,180.)
set CG[5]=M3V(KR,225.,225.)
set CG[6]=M3V(KR,250.,270.)
set CG[7]=M3V(KR,225.,315.)
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02K',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),CG[0],GetUnitFacing(GetTriggerUnit()))
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02K',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),CG[1],GetUnitFacing(GetTriggerUnit()))
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02K',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),CG[2],GetUnitFacing(GetTriggerUnit()))
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02K',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),CG[3],GetUnitFacing(GetTriggerUnit()))
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02K',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),CG[4],GetUnitFacing(GetTriggerUnit()))
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02K',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),CG[5],GetUnitFacing(GetTriggerUnit()))
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02K',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),CG[6],GetUnitFacing(GetTriggerUnit()))
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02K',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),CG[7],GetUnitFacing(GetTriggerUnit()))
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02K',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),KR,GetRandomReal(0,360))
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02K',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),KR,GetRandomReal(0,360))
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02K',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),KR,GetRandomReal(0,360))
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02K',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),KR,GetRandomReal(0,360))
set ME=PBV('h02K')
call ForGroupBJ(ME,
function XLE)
call DestroyGroup(ME)
call RemoveLocation(KR)
call ForGroupBJ(PBV('h02K'),
function XME)
call EnableTrigger(R4)
call EnableTrigger(I4)
call EnableTrigger(N4)
call EnableTrigger(A4)
call EnableTrigger(O4)
call TriggerSleepAction(8.)
call PauseUnit(GetTriggerUnit(),false)
if(XPE())then
call SetUnitInvulnerable(GetTriggerUnit(),false)
endif
call SelectUnitForPlayerSingle(TF,GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))
call SetUnitTimeScalePercent(TF,100.)
set AE=OffsetLocation(GetUnitLoc(TF),.0,-625.)
call PanCameraToTimedLocForPlayer(GetOwningPlayer(TF),AE,0)
call RemoveLocation(AE)
call DisableTrigger(R4)
call DisableTrigger(I4)
call DisableTrigger(B4)
call DisableTrigger(O4)
call DisableTrigger(A4)
call DisableTrigger(N4)
call SetUnitAnimation(TF,"stand")
call RemoveLocation(WF)
endfunction
